overall_intent: Refine a restrained photographic school-life scene of four fictional university students taking responsibility for a shared place: the reference-informed chair receives two visible show-of-hands votes while a separate peer records the meeting in an ordinary classroom. Search only for material useful to the concrete activity, directed social response and physical teaching-room context. The school-life topic, human lead and reference-use scope remain frozen; agent-authored staging and the unchanged predeclared testcase gates remain distinct from requester-owned meaning.

action.reason: The show-of-hands activity and simultaneous recording make the chosen self-government event visible rather than relying on a genre label.
action.expressive_goal: Students visibly carry out one collective decision through owned raised hands, with the meeting being recorded by a separate participant.
observable_targets: Two seated voters each raise one owned hand above their own shoulder.
The minute taker writes locally in an open notebook at the shared table.
owner_relations: Each raised hand and connected arm belongs to its own seated voter.
The separate writer’s hand and writing tool act on the open notebook at the same meeting table.
required_constraints: A school-life photograph retains one human central student portrayed using the supplied portrait’s visible facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and fine separated fringe.
Four distinct students form one meeting: a chair, two voters and a minute taker; each raised hand belongs to its corresponding voter.
Both raised hands, the chair’s directed response, the minute taker’s writing action and the teaching-room context remain assessable together in one photograph.
preserved_choices: Retain two broad, separate raised-hand signals rather than substituting tiny ballot markings.
Keep the writer distinct from both voters and the reference-informed chair.
open_scope: Refine the legible instant, local arm articulation and separation of the voting hands within open action, pose, body_geometry and composition dimensions.
Refine conventional writing posture while keeping its visible hand-to-notebook relation.
action.role_focus: Two seated student representatives take a show-of-hands vote, each lifting one owned hand clearly above shoulder level; a separate peer writes minutes.
action.scene_context: A four-student university council meeting at classroom desks after lessons, led by a reference-informed chair who receives the voters’ answer.
